raw_site_text: 62 schools were located in the state of Chiapas and the remaining 18 schools were in the three states of Hidalgo, Queretaro, and Veracruz
justification: The first experiment randomized 80 schools, 62 in Chiapas and 18 in Hidalgo, Queretaro, and Veracruz, while the second experiment and scale-up analysis were in Chiapas only.
note: Predominantly Chiapas (second experiment, 224 schools, and scale-up sample are Chiapas only); the other three states enter only via the 18 schools of the first experiment.
